title: Extract calculations into testable module
story: As a developer, I want fiscal maths separated from UI so it can be unit-tested.
description: Separate fiscal maths from the Streamlit UI into an importable, unit-testable module.
acceptance_criteria: compute_fiscal() accepts baseline, revenue levers, investment levers and assumptions
Returns static figures and a year-by-year projection structure
app.py is reduced to control collection and rendering
